anchor_value: USD-denominated fair value column shown with dollar sign

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Jonathan Acquisition Company | First Lien Secured Debt - Term Loan | S + 510 , 1.00 % Floor | 12/22/2026 | $ | 7,835 | $ | 7,790 | $ | 7,739

rationale: FX02 is a single-cell currency/unit flag on fair_value_currency. The flagged value is U_USD, and the raw schedule of investments presents fair value amounts in dollar-denominated columns; for example, table 10 row 4 shows the fair value cell preceded by '$'. The source therefore supports USD denomination, so treating the XBRL unit label U_USD as non-USD is the check defect rather than a data error.
